Bihar MoU: bihar ko kendr ki bari saugat!, nadiyon ki gad se banengi sarken| CM Samrat |Nitin Gadkari |Bihar News
Kendriy sarak parivhan evan rajmarg mantralay ke sath bihar sarkar ne ek aham samjhaute par hastakshar kiya hai....iske tahat bihar ke jal nikayon se vaigyanik tarike se gad nikalne aur nikali gaee upyukt gad ka neshnal haeeve, stet haeeve aur relve ke nirman men upyog ke lie prayog kiya jayega...bari bat ye ki is samjhaute ke tahat jalashyon se gad nikalne men bihar sarkar ka ek bhi rupya kharch nahin hoga...sara kharch kendr sarkar uthayegi.
